title: INT8-Quantization Robustness for Edge-FPGA License-Plate Recognition: artefacts
description:
Scripts, calibration configurations, compiled INT8 models and per-run result files behind the paper "INT8-Quantization Robustness for Edge-FPGA License-Plate Recognition: A Two-Stage Thai ANPR System on the AMD Kria KV260" (IEEE Access, under revision, manuscript Access-2026-35199).

Includes the multi-seed csp4 ablation, the quantization-aware training comparison, per-layer activation statistics with simulated INT8 SQNR, on-board latency and power measurements on a Kria KV260, and a cross-domain replication on CCPD2020 and Open Images V7.
